cipherLabel: Cipher (auto-detected on decrypt, no need to choose)
profileHintPostQuantum: The file key is wrapped with ML-KEM-1024 as well, so opening a file means breaking both algorithms, not either one. Applies to multi-select and whole-folder encryption alike. Measured cost: about 0.07 ms and 1.6 KB per file.
profileHintClassic: AES-256 already withstands quantum search on its own - Grover's algorithm only reduces it to 128-bit strength. Choose this for containers that older builds must be able to open.
profileHintChacha: Faster on machines without AES hardware acceleration. Same 256-bit key strength.
deleteSourceOnEncryptLabel: Securely delete the original file or folder after encrypting (overwritten then deleted, bypasses the Recycle Bin, unrecoverable)
deleteSourceOnEncryptHint: For a folder, every file inside it is overwritten one by one and the whole tree is then removed. Links are never followed, so nothing outside the folder is touched.
pickedFileNotFolderToast: {{count}} selection(s) are not encrypted folders - use "Decrypt files" for those
deleteSourceOnDecryptLabel: Securely delete the encrypted file or encrypted folder after decrypting (overwritten then deleted, bypasses the Recycle Bin, unrecoverable)
deleteSourceOnDecryptHint: This deletes the .ivault container itself - the files just restored from it are not touched.
sourceNotDeletedError: The source file/folder could not be securely deleted - the original content is still on disk: {{reason}}
scanRemnantsButton: Scan for plaintext remnants... (checks WPS/Office auto-backups, etc.)
remnantCleanToast: No plaintext remnants found (no matches in the same folder / WPS auto-backup / Office AutoRecover)
remnantFoundWarningToast: Found {{count}} plaintext remnant(s) related to the source file - please confirm cleanup below
remnantCleanupSuccessToast: Securely deleted {{count}} remnant file(s) (overwritten then deleted)
selectEncryptOutputDirTitle: Select a save directory for the encrypted files
decryptFailedNoValidFilesToast: Decryption failed: none of the {{count}} selected files are valid encrypted containers
dropMixedTypesToast: The dropped files mix .ivault files with regular files - drop them separately
selectDecryptOutputDirTitle: Select a save directory for the decrypted files
decryptPreviewSkippedHint: {{count}} other file(s) couldn't be read and will be skipped
selectFolderDecryptOutputDirTitle: Select where to put the decrypted folder
folderDecryptPreviewHint: Contains {{count}} file(s) - pick a destination after confirming
selectFilesToScanTitle: Select encrypted file(s) to check for remnants (multi-select supported)
remnantsExplanation: These files may be plaintext copies - even after the original is encrypted and securely deleted, content can still be recovered from them (WPS's "document repair / deep scan" actually works by searching the whole disk for same-named copies and its own auto-backups, not by parsing the encrypted file itself). Items in the source directory / editor backups related to the source file are checked by default;
remnantsSameNameWarning: "same-name copies on disk" are NOT checked by default
remnantsExplanationTail: - one of them might be a real original you want to keep, so confirm each one before deleting; check them too once you're sure nothing plaintext should remain.
aiSummaryTruncatedHint: The file was too large - only the first part was summarized
aiNotTextFileToast: This file doesn't look like readable text, so it can't be summarized
aiConfirmSendBody: The decrypted content of this file will be sent to DeepSeek's cloud service to generate a summary. Continue?
reencryptButtonHint: Compare a folder against an existing encrypted container to see exactly what changed before re-encrypting
reencryptSelectFolderTitle: Select the folder to check (current latest content)
reencryptSelectContainerTitle: Select the matching encrypted .ivault container (older version)
reencryptNoChangesHint: No changes found ({{count}} files match the container) - no need to re-encrypt.
shareModeHint: The file key is sealed with the passphrase only, not with this device's identity: any other Tessera install can open it with the passphrase. Send the passphrase over a different channel. Not combinable with the post-quantum profile.
sharePassSetHint: Derived with Argon2id (256 MiB, 3 passes), once per batch. A lost passphrase cannot be recovered.
verifyNoPlaintextHint: Authenticates every chunk and the whole-file SHA-256. Plaintext only passes through memory and is never written to disk.
opsEmpty: Encrypt, decrypt or verify something to see timing and throughput here
algorithmShareNote: Passphrase sharing is on: this batch uses {{algorithm}}, wrapped by the passphrase only and not bound to this device.
clearSessionStatsHint: Resets this session's throughput and counters; the history is kept
decryptTileSummary: Restore .ivault files or encrypted folders — the algorithm is detected automatically
dropHint: Drop files anywhere: .ivault files are decrypted, everything else is encrypted
dropIvaultOnEncryptToast: These are already encrypted (.ivault) — drop them on Decrypt instead
dropPlainOnDecryptToast: Only .ivault files can be decrypted — drop plain files on Encrypt
encryptTileSummary: Turn files or whole folders into .ivault containers that only this device (or whoever holds the passphrase) can open
scanRemnantsDescription: Checks WPS/Office auto-backups, same-folder copies and other places plaintext may linger
secureDeleteIrreversible: Overwritten, then deleted — skips the Recycle Bin and cannot be undone.
panelMetricsTitle: Metrics shown at the top of the page
